about: Kerb rules read by hand from council PDFs and maps. Each entry paints one side (or both) of a named street within `radius` metres of `near` [lon, lat]. Rules use Kerb's tuple: [hours, days(0=Sun), from, to, $/hr (-1 = meter, rate unknown), public holidays, 0 park / 1 no parking, note].
